visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of large, orange, modular leveling blocks stacked on a white display table in an indoor exhibition environment. A man wearing a blue vest and carrying a tan shoulder bag walks past the display towards the background. (2) The camera transitions to a selfie-style shot of a man in a black shirt standing in a large, brightly lit hall. Behind him is a large digital screen displaying 'TAIPEI AMPA' branding with vibrant red and blue colors. (3) The man walks through an exhibition hall filled with people and automotive displays. He approaches a white Volkswagen camper van with a roof tent. (4) The camera shows several close-up shots of various automotive lighting equipment, including long LED light bars and circular driving lights with 'Driving Light' signage on the table. (5) A robotic arm is shown scanning or demonstrating a car floor mat on a display stand. (6) A montage follows showing various car parts: chrome wheel covers, a red sports car, a green vintage Volkswagen Beetle, and an electric vehicle chassis. (7) The man enters a camper van, showing the wooden interior furniture and a 'PlayGO' branded cooler. (8) The video concludes with the man back at the initial display, showing how the orange modular blocks can be stacked and used as vehicle leveling ramps.
